Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
# Liberal Democrats 2024 Manifesto Summary

## Overview
The Liberal Democrats present a comprehensive policy platform built around five themes: economy, public services, environment, international relations, and democratic reform.

## Economy and Business
The party proposes increased investment in renewable energy and home insulation to reduce energy bills and create jobs. Key economic policies include:
- Replacing business rates with a Commercial Landowner Levy
- Creating Lifelong Skills Grants (£5,000) for adult education
- Expanding apprenticeships and reforming the apprenticeship levy
- Supporting small businesses through expanded British Business Bank lending
- Establishing an industrial strategy focused on green technologies and digital sectors

## Healthcare and Social Care
Healthcare proposals centre on:
- Guaranteeing GP appointments within seven days (24 hours for urgent cases) through recruiting 8,000 additional GPs
- Expanding NHS dentistry access and reforming dental contracts
- Mental health support including walk-in hubs for young people
- Cancer treatment guarantee within 62 days of urgent referral
- Introducing free personal care for elderly individuals
- Establishing a Royal College of Care Workers with improved wages

## Education
Education commitments include:
- Mental health professionals in all primary and secondary schools
- Free school meals extended to all children in poverty
- Increased per-pupil funding above inflation
- Tutoring guarantee for disadvantaged pupils
- Maintenance grants for university students
- Curriculum reform through a standing commission

## Environment
Environmental policies focus on:
- Net zero emissions target by 2045
- Emergency home insulation programme with free upgrades for low-income households
- 90% renewable electricity generation by 2030
- Transforming water companies into public benefit companies
- Banning sewage discharges into bathing waters by 2030
- Planting 60 million trees annually
- Creating a Clean Air Act based on WHO guidelines

## Housing
Housing proposals include:
- Building 380,000 homes annually, including 150,000 social homes
- Ten new garden cities
- Abolishing residential leasehold
- Banning no-fault evictions with three-year default tenancies
- National register of licensed landlords
- Ending rough sleeping within one parliamentary term

## Transport
Transport investments encompass:
- Accelerated electric vehicle charging infrastructure
- Rail fare freeze and simplified ticketing
- Extended rail electrification and Northern Powerhouse Rail
- Enhanced local authority powers over bus services
- New cycling and walking networks
- Increased road maintenance funding for potholes

## Immigration and Asylum
The party proposes:
- Repealing the Illegal Migration Act
- Processing asylum claims within three months
- Allowing asylum seekers to work after three months
- Expanding safe legal routes for refugees
- Removing the Rwanda deportation scheme
- Reforming work visa systems with flexible merit-based approaches

## Democratic Reform
Constitutional changes include:
- Proportional representation (Single Transferable Vote) for parliamentary and English local elections
- Voting age reduced to 16
- Ministerial Code enshrined in law
- House of Lords reform with elected members
- Donation caps for political parties
- Written federal constitution

## International Relations
Foreign policy priorities include:
- Rebuilding EU relationship with eventual Single Market membership
- Continued Ukraine support
- NATO commitment with defence spending increases toward 2.5% GDP
- Restoring international development spending to 0.7% of national income
- Two-state solution advocacy for Israel-Palestine
- Maintaining nuclear deterrent while pursuing disarmament

## Funding
Revenue proposals include reversing bank tax cuts, increasing Digital Services Tax, capital gains tax reform, and windfall taxes on energy company profits.
